bullets.text: Apple's 50th Anniversary Finale - Paul McCartney likely to headline Apple's grand celebration this week.
Age Verification Rollout - **Apple** expands age verification methods in the UK for account security.
Apple Subsidiary Fined - **Apple** faces a £390,000 fine in the UK for breaching Russia sanctions.
AirPods Max 2 Launch - **Apple** reveals enhanced features in the new AirPods Max 2, including improved ANC.
England vs. Japan Livestream - Watch the international friendly match for free on **ITV** in the UK.
AI Upgrades in iOS 27 - Upcoming **iOS 27** may introduce a new autocorrect feature for iPhone keyboards.
Amazon's Big Spring Sale - Discounts on tech gadgets, including **Apple** products, end tonight.
AI Seed Startups Valuations - Seed-stage AI startups are seeing higher valuations as investor interest surges.
ChatGPT Now on CarPlay - **Apple** users can access **ChatGPT** via CarPlay with the latest iOS update.
Samsung's Motion Sickness App - **Samsung** launches Hearapy app to alleviate motion sickness using sound.
